methodologyNotes: Dataset covers twelve hard-sided cooler models from the highest-search rotomolded and classic hard coolers in the US market, spanning budget blow-molded chest coolers through premium rotomolded ice chests. Specs were re-verified June 2026 against manufacturer product pages and authorized-retailer listings (Dick's, Bass Pro, Cabela's, Target, Walmart, Home Depot, ABO Outfitters, Toolup) plus independent reviews (AmazingRibs, ManMakesFire, TreelineReview, OutdoorGearLab, Pro Tool Reviews). Prices reflect published US MSRP or the prevailing retail/MAP price at time of research. can_capacity follows the manufacturer 2:1 ice-to-can figure where published. ice_retention_days reflects the manufacturer claim. rotomolded and bear_resistant_certified are booleans (true=confirmed yes, false=confirmed no, null=unverified). ADVERSARIAL CORRECTIONS APPLIED: YETI Tundra 45 price corrected 350->325 (current YETI MSRP, dropped from prior $350); YETI Tundra 45 can_capacity 26->28 and Tundra 65 42->39 (YETI official 2:1 figures); Cabela's Polar Cap Equalizer 60 price corrected 299.99->149.99 (it is a budget foam cooler, not a $300 rotomolded box); ORCA 40 empty_weight nulled (ORCA states a 23-28 lb range, retailer listings 24-30 lb, no single reliable figure). ORCA ceased manufacturing January 2025 (verified via Shop Eat Surf Outdoor); brand discontinued, only residual retail stock; $319.99 is the last Walmart price. accessedAt 2026-06-20.

products.name: YETI Tundra 45 Hard Cooler
products.priceNote: Current YETI MSRP June 2026; confirmed at Worldwide Golf Shops, MeatEater store and Dick's (was $350 in prior pricing)
products.provenance: Price corrected to $325, the current YETI MSRP verified across multiple authorized retailers (Worldwide Golf Shops, MeatEater branded store, Dick's). The drafted $350 was the prior price. Empty weight 24.6 lb and IGBC bear-resistant certification + rotomolded construction confirmed via YETI spec/size guide and TreelineReview. YETI publishes no single ice-retention-day claim, so null (field tests ~5-10 days). Can capacity corrected 26->28: YETI official 2:1 ice-ratio figure (max cans-only is 54).

products.name: YETI Tundra 65 Hard Cooler
products.priceNote: YETI MSRP; confirmed at Dunhams Sports and Ace Hardware June 2026
products.provenance: Price $395 confirmed at Dunhams Sports and Ace Hardware. Empty weight 30.3 lb is YETI's published spec (some retailer listings cite ~27-29 lb for the actual interior 57.2 qt). IGBC bear-resistant certification and rotomolded construction confirmed. Can capacity corrected 42->39: YETI official 2:1 ice-ratio figure (cans-only max is 77). No published ice-retention-day claim, so null.

products.name: RTIC 45 QT Ultra-Tough Hard Cooler
products.provenance: All specs re-confirmed directly from rticoutdoors.com product page: price $239, empty weight 29.5 lb, 60-can capacity, up to 5 days ice retention, rotomolded construction, Rapid V-Drain Dual Plug drain system. Bear-resistant certification not claimed by RTIC; set to false. No changes from draft.

products.name: Coleman Xtreme 5-Day 70-Quart Hard Cooler
products.priceNote: Typical retail price at Walmart/Home Depot (observed ~$118-120); Coleman.com does not publish a separate MSRP
products.provenance: Price ~$119 confirmed at Walmart (current ~$118.95). 100-can capacity and 5-day ice retention at 90F confirmed across multiple retailer listings. Construction is injection/blow-molded polypropylene (not rotomolded), confirmed. Empty weight ~14 lb per retailer data (varies 12.4-14 lb). Bear resistance not claimed. Source URL switched to Home Depot product page (coleman.com xtreme-series category page returned 403 and is not a single-product page).

products.provenance: Target price $174.99 (sale, 33% off) / $259.99 regular confirmed directly. Empty weight 16.34 lb and 83-can capacity confirmed at Amazon. Blow-molded construction (not rotomolded) confirmed. 5-day ice retention per Igloo marketing. Garden-hose-compatible threaded drain plug. IGBC certification not claimed. No spec changes from draft.

products.name: Pelican Elite 50QT Hard Cooler
products.priceNote: Pelican Official Store / elitecooler.com price (Walmart and Amazon discount to ~$299.95)
products.provenance: Price $310.95 confirmed on the Pelican Official Store and elitecooler.com (third-party retailers Walmart/Amazon discount to ~$299.95). 38-can capacity, 26.39 lb weight, and up to 8 days ice retention confirmed. Source URL upgraded to the official Pelican product page. No spec changes from draft.

products.name: Cabela's Polar Cap Equalizer 60-Quart Cooler
products.priceNote: Current price at Cabela's / Bass Pro Shops June 2026 (corrected from drafted $299.99)
products.provenance: PRICE CORRECTED 299.99->149.99: the Cabela's Polar Cap Equalizer 60-qt is a foam-insulated value cooler starting at $149.99 at Cabela's/Bass Pro, NOT a $300 cooler. Weight 30 lb (37 x 19.5 x 18.75 in) and up to 7-day ice retention confirmed via retailer descriptions and ManMakesFire long-term review. Rotomolded per ManMakesFire. Bear-resistant design has molded padlock tabs but no IGBC certification claimed; false. Can capacity not published for this size; null.

products.name: Lifetime 55-Quart High Performance Cooler
products.provenance: All specs re-confirmed directly at lifetime.com: price $189, 55 qt, 60-can-with-ice capacity, empty weight 23.4 lb, up to 7-day ice retention. Heavy-duty polyethylene construction (not rotomolded). IGBC bear-resistant certification explicitly stated ('certified to withstand a bear for up to an hour when locked') at lifetime.com and Walmart. Garden-hose-compatible drain. No changes from draft.

products.name: Engel 65 High Performance Hard Cooler

No changes from draft.

products.name: Grizzly 40-Quart Rotomolded Cooler
products.priceNote: Standard-color price per ABO Outfitters / Grizzly Coolers (co-branded colors $327.99)
products.provenance: Price $299.99 (standard colors) and IGBC Certification No. 3369 (model IRP-9080) confirmed at ABO Outfitters and Grizzly Coolers; all Grizzly hardside coolers are IGBC bear-resistant certified. Empty weight 24 lb confirmed. RotoTough rotationally-molded construction and 2-inch quick-drain plug confirmed. products.name: ORCA 40-Quart Hard Cooler
products.priceNote: Last published price (Walmart, $319.99) before ORCA ceased operations January 2025; now discontinued, residual retail stock only
products.provenance: ORCA (Outdoor Recreation Company of America, under Gathr Outdoors) ceased all operations January 2025 per Shop Eat Surf Outdoor; brand discontinued, residual retail stock only. Last published price $319.99 (Walmart). Can capacity 40-48 with ice per theorcacoolers.com (48 = upper with-ice figure). EMPTY WEIGHT NULLED: theorcacoolers.com states a 23-28 lb range, Amazon lists 24 lb dry, other listings up to 30 lb, with no single reliable figure; null beats a guess (draft's 27 was an unsupported mid-point). IGBC certification explicitly NOT claimed by ORCA; false. Up to 10-day ice retention and rotomolded one-piece construction confirmed.
